name: LiteLLM
summary: LiteLLM is an open-source Python SDK and self-hosted gateway that calls 100+ LLM providers through one OpenAI-style interface. The proxy adds virtual keys, per-team budgets, rate limits, spend tracking and retry/fallback routing. It is maintained by BerriAI, which sells an enterprise tier with SSO and audit logs.
facts: Yes, Python SDK or proxy server
Open source free; paid enterprise tier
Virtual keys, budgets, cost tracking, fallbacks, auto-router
goodFor: Self-hosted gateway inside your own network
Per-team keys, budgets and spend reports
watchOut: Release pipeline compromised twice in 2026 (Mar and Oct); pin versions
Frequent releases; operations and upgrades are on you
Some governance features need the enterprise license
